description: This file contains a utility class 'ProductImageSizeUtils' with static methods for resizing images in various ways, including simple resizing, resizing with hints, and resizing with aspect ratio preservation.

classes.name: ProductImageSizeUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for resizing images in different manners (simple resize, resize with quality hints, resize maintaining aspect ratio).

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Performs a simple resize of the given BufferedImage without maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: resizeWithHint
methods.description: Resizes an image with specified rendering hints and an option for higher quality via multi-step scaling.

methods.name: resizeWithRatio
methods.description: Resizes an image while maintaining aspect ratio based on destination width and height, adjusting dimensions to fit within bounds.
